name: jira-to-openspec
description: Download Jira issues and whole epics as OpenSpec change proposals, and push them back to Jira.

jiraToOpenspec.token.description: Jira token (Cloud: API token; Server/DC: Personal Access Token).

jiraToOpenspec.email.description: Atlassian account e-mail. Cloud only; Server/DC ignores it.

jiraToOpenspec.openspecFolder.description: The OpenSpec folder. Issues are saved to its changes/ subfolder. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

jiraToOpenspec.changeField.description: Where an issue keeps its OpenSpec change name: "labels" (a label such as openspec:add-2fa), or a custom text field given by id (customfield_10050) or by name (OpenSpec Change).

jiraToOpenspec.changeLabelPrefix.description: With changeField set to "labels": the prefix that marks the label holding the change name.

scripts.test: node test/client-test.js && node test/wiki-test.js && node test/change-field-test.js && node test/openspec-paths-test.js && node test/preview-button-test.js && node test/commands-test.js
